notablePrerequisites:
Mobile Garrison is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Mobile Garrison.
description:
Declare Mobile Garrison as an attacker.
Mobile Garrison triggers, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
